Fresh Stock: Supplied goods mus t be brand new, unused, and from the latest manufacturing batch. Dried-up ink products or rusted metallic items will be rejected. 2. Delivery & Inspection Terms Consignee Site Inspection: Final inspection and counting of the stationery it ems will be conducted a t the buyer's delivery location. Single Lot Delivery: The entire ordered quantity m ust be delivered in a single lot within the stipulat ed delivery period (e.g., 15–30 days). Piecemeal or partia l deliveries will not be entertained. Defective Replacement: Any damaged, leaking, or sub-standard items f ound during inspection must be replaced by the vendor within 7 working days at no extra cost. . 3. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 6. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 7. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted.
